simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to זֵרוּעַ (H2221) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: זֵרוּעַ (zêrûwaʻ) means something sown , i.e. a plant First listed occurrence: Isa 61 11.

definitions.full: H2221. zerua זֵרוּעַ noun [masculine] sowing, thing sown (intensive formative according to Ol § 186 b Sta § 228 , yet on this and following compare Ba NB 42, 178 Anm. 4 ) — ז ׳זֶרַע Lev 11:37 (P), תַצְמִיךְַ זֵָֽרוּעֶיהָ כְּגַנָּה Isa 61:11 in simile of Yahweh's causing righteousness to spring up.
